39 def campaign_initiatives(steps, resolved=None):
40     """The Campaign's heading steps (each defines its own root group) with their parts.
41 
42     An initiative = a step that defines a root navigation group whose id is its own id (PLAN §3);
43     its parts = the steps whose navigation path starts with that id. A part's kind comes from its
44     ``ref`` prefix (project · step · deliverable · calendar) or is a native task; its text, state,
45     date and link come from the resolver when it points at another record."""
46     resolved = resolved or {}
47     steps = [s for s in (steps or ()) if isinstance(s, dict)]
48     heads = []
49     for s in steps:
50         nav = s.get("navigation") if isinstance(s.get("navigation"), dict) else {}
51         groups = nav.get("groups") or []
52         own = next((g for g in groups if isinstance(g, dict) and g.get("id") == s.get("id") and g.get("parent_id") is None), None)
53         if own is not None:
54             heads.append((s, own))
55     out = []
56     for s, own in heads:
57         sid = s.get("id")
58         parts = []
59         for p in steps:
60             if p is s:
61                 continue
62             nav = p.get("navigation") if isinstance(p.get("navigation"), dict) else {}
63             path = nav.get("path") or []
64             if path and path[0] == sid:
65                 r = resolved.get(str(p.get("id"))) or {}
66                 ref = str(p.get("ref") or "")
67                 kind = ref.split(":", 1)[0] if ref else "task"
68                 state = r.get("state") or ("" if r.get("broken") else str(p.get("status") or ""))
69                 parts.append({
70                     "id": p.get("id"), "kind": kind, "name": p.get("name") or "", "text": r.get("what") or p.get("name") or "",
71                     "target": r.get("name") or "", "state": state, "date": r.get("date") or p.get("due") or "",
72                     "pid": str(r.get("pid") or ""), "lead": str(r.get("lead") or ""), "dir": str(r.get("dir") or ""),
73                     "href": r.get("href") or "", "status": str(p.get("status") or ""),
74                     "target_status": str(r.get("target_status") or ""),
75                     "broken": bool(r.get("broken")) if ref else False, "gap": r.get("gap") or "",
76                     "waiting_on": str(p.get("waiting_on") or "") if not ref else "",
77                     "needs_you": "waiting on you" in str(state).lower() or (
78                         not ref and str(p.get("status") or "") == "waiting"
79                         and bool(re.search(r"\b(john|you|me)\b", str(p.get("waiting_on") or "").lower()))),
80                     # the seat (2026-09-30, his three levels): a component he works interactively — a cockpit, an
81                     # effort, a desk item — sits in its goal (""), on deck, or active, in his order
82                     "seat": str(p.get("seat")) if p.get("seat") in ("active", "deck") else "",
83                     "seat_order": int(p["seat_order"]) if isinstance(p.get("seat_order"), int) else None,
84                     "goal": sid, "goal_name": s.get("name") or sid,
85                 })
86         # W1 (2026-09-28): a referenced part is closed when its RESOLVED target is — done, cancelled, dropped or
87         # parked — not only when the wrapper's own status says so (Grok's live replay, 2026-09-27: a done target
88         # stayed the open "next" part while its wrapper was planned). An unavailable target is broken: named, never
89         # next. Every reader of a part (the light, the rows, the board's chips and ticks) reads these two flags,
90         # never the wrapper's status alone (Grok W1).
91         for p in parts:
92             p["done"] = p["status"] == "done" or p["target_status"] == "done"
93             p["closed"] = p["status"] in ("done", "parked") or p["target_status"] in ("done", "cancelled", "dropped", "parked")
94         open_parts = [p for p in parts if not p["closed"] and not p["broken"]]
95         dates = sorted(p["date"] for p in open_parts if p["date"])
96         out.append({
97             "id": sid, "name": s.get("name") or sid, "tier": int(s["tier"]) if s.get("tier") in (1, 2, 3) else None,
98             "order": int((own or {}).get("order") or 0), "area": str(s.get("area") or ""),
99             "done_when": s.get("done_when") or "", "status": s.get("status") or "",
100             "if_then": str(s.get("if_then") or ""),      # the Star Chart's one if-then step, in his words (2026-10-03)
101             "parts": parts, "next": open_parts[0] if open_parts else None,
102             "needs": [p for p in parts if p["needs_you"]], "next_deadline": dates[0] if dates else "",
103             "done_count": sum(1 for p in parts if p["done"]),
104             # the pace he drives the goal toward (2026-09-29); the parts' progress. The goal itself has no seat: its
105             # components do (his three levels, 2026-09-30)
106             "pace": str(s.get("pace") or ""),
107             "open_count": len(open_parts), "part_count": sum(1 for p in parts if not p["broken"]),
108         })
109     out.sort(key=lambda i: (i["tier"] or 9, i["order"], i["name"]))   # an untiered initiative sorts last, its tier shown as missing
110     for n, i in enumerate(out, 1):
111         i["number"] = n
112     return out

130 def loose_initiative(steps, resolved=None):
131     """The components with no goal yet - a cockpit or an effort put on the desk from the Candidates (2026-10-02) -
132     as ONE hidden initiative (nogoal=True) so the shelves, the head and the pick-up see them; it is never drawn or
133     counted as a goal. None when there are none."""
134     steps = [s for s in (steps or ()) if isinstance(s, dict)]
135     heads = {s.get("id") for s in steps for g in ((s.get("navigation") or {}).get("groups") or []) if isinstance(g, dict) and g.get("id") == s.get("id") and g.get("parent_id") is None}
136     loose = []
137     for s in steps:
138         nav = s.get("navigation") if isinstance(s.get("navigation"), dict) else {}
139         ref = str(s.get("ref") or "")
140         if s.get("id") in heads or (nav.get("path") or []) or ref.split(":", 1)[0] not in ("project", "effort"):
141             continue
142         x = dict(s); x["navigation"] = {"path": [NOGOAL_ID]}
143         loose.append(x)
144     if not loose:
145         return None
146     head = {"id": NOGOAL_ID, "name": "no goal yet", "status": "active", "tier": 9, "order": 999,
147             "navigation": {"groups": [{"id": NOGOAL_ID, "parent_id": None}]}}
148     out = campaign_initiatives([head] + loose, resolved)
149     if not out:
150         return None
151     out[0]["nogoal"] = True
152     return out[0]

176 def initiative_light(i, working=None):
177     """One word for an initiative, read from its parts (John, 2026-09-27: "whether action is needed — working, waiting,
178     idle"): ``needs`` when a part waits on him; ``working`` when a referenced project has a running session or a busy
179     steward (``ctx["working"]``); ``waiting`` when an open part waits on something else; else ``idle``."""
180     working = working or set()
181     if i.get("needs"):
182         return "needs"
183     open_parts = [p for p in i.get("parts") or () if not p.get("closed", p.get("status") in ("done", "parked")) and not p.get("broken")]
184     if any(p.get("pid") and p["pid"] in working for p in open_parts):
185         return "working"
186     if any(str(p.get("state") or "").startswith("waiting") or p.get("status") == "waiting" for p in open_parts):
187         return "waiting"
188     return "idle"

191 def initiative_line(i):
192     """The one sentence a compact initiative tile carries (Grok R8: the action, not the part's name): when a part waits
193     on him, the wait itself — a project part's "waiting on you: …" without its prefix, a native part's trigger, else
194     the part's text; else the next open part; else what done looks like. Returns (html, kind)."""
195     if i.get("needs"):
196         p = i["needs"][0]
197         state = str(p.get("state") or "")
198         low = state.lower()
199         if "waiting on you:" in low:
200             words = state[low.index("waiting on you:") + len("waiting on you:"):].strip()
201         elif p.get("waiting_on") and str(p["waiting_on"]).strip().lower() not in ("john", "you", "me"):
202             words = "%s &mdash; %s" % (esc(p.get("text") or ""), esc(p["waiting_on"]))
203             return "&#9873; " + words, "wait"
204         else:
205             words = ""
206         text = esc(words) if words else esc(p.get("text") or p.get("target") or "")
207         return "&#9873; " + text, "wait"
208     nxt = i.get("next")
209     if nxt:
210         return "Next: " + esc(nxt.get("text") or "") + ((" &middot; " + esc(_short(nxt["date"]))) if nxt.get("date") else ""), "next"
211     if i.get("done_when"):
212         return "Done looks like: " + esc(i["done_when"]), "done"
213     return "nothing open", "none"

233 def ruler_weeks(today):
234     mon = today - timedelta(days=today.weekday())
235     weeks = []
236     for k in range(5):
237         a = mon + timedelta(days=7 * k)
238         b = a + timedelta(days=6)
239         label = "%s–%d" % (_hr.short_date(a.isoformat()), b.day) if a.month == b.month else "%s–%s" % (_hr.short_date(a.isoformat()), _hr.short_date(b.isoformat()))
240         weeks.append({"start": a, "end": b, "label": label, "name": "this week" if k == 0 else "week %d" % (k + 1)})
241     return weeks
242 
243 
244 def ruler_markers(facts, today):
245     """Every open dated step across the records, bucketed into the five weeks and beyond; a date
246     already past sits in this week and says overdue."""
247     weeks = ruler_weeks(today)
248     buckets = {k: [] for k in range(5)}
249     beyond, overdue = [], []
250     for f in facts or ():
251         if not isinstance(f, dict):
252             continue
253         for st in f.get("dated") or ():
254             d = _hr._iso(st.get("due"))
255             if d is None:
256                 continue
257             m = {"date": st["due"], "name": st.get("name", ""), "project_id": f.get("id", ""),
258                  "project_name": f.get("name", ""), "needs": bool(f.get("needs_you")),
259                  "overdue": d < today, "label": _hr.due_label(st["due"], today)}
260             if d < weeks[0]["start"]:
261                 overdue.append(m)          # before this Monday: overdue, not this week's delivery
262                 continue
263             placed = False
264             for k, w in enumerate(weeks):
265                 if w["start"] <= d <= w["end"]:
266                     buckets[k].append(m); placed = True; break
267             if not placed:
268                 beyond.append(m)
269     for k in buckets:
270         buckets[k].sort(key=lambda m: (m["date"], m["name"]))
271     beyond.sort(key=lambda m: (m["date"], m["name"]))
272     overdue.sort(key=lambda m: (m["date"], m["name"]))
273     return weeks, buckets, beyond, overdue

283 def anchor_tab_stem(brand=None):
284     """Which anchor a browser tab wears. His export (anchor-icon.*) is a dark painting: scaled to 16 px on a dark tab
285     strip it read as no icon at all (his tab strip, captured 2026-10-01: "where are my icons in Chrome tabs?"). When the
286     tab drawing of the same anchor is there (anchor-tab.ico + its 32 and 16 px PNGs - his painting redrawn for the small
287     sizes) the tab wears that; his export stays the large icon (the touch icon, the desktop, the app). None = no anchor."""
288     brand = brand or BRAND_DIR
289     if all((brand / f).is_file() for f in ("anchor-tab.ico", "anchor-tab-32.png", "anchor-tab-16.png")):
290         return "anchor-tab"

293     return None

296 def tab_icon_link(name, build, anchor=None):
297     """A page's tab icon. His rule (2026-10-01 18:1x): "the cave of wonders and the campaign web pages should have the
298     cave of wonders icon in the tab; the rest of the other tabs should have the new anchor icon." So the High Seat and
299     the Campaign page call this with ``anchor=False`` and the steward's High Seat picture; every other page wears the
300     anchor (``anchor`` None = when the files exist): the set he dropped into vendor/brand at 13:12, its small sizes from
301     the tab drawing when that is there (``anchor_tab_stem``), the 180 px touch icon always his export.
302     The picture rule (2026-09-30: "the icons in the web page tabs are missing"): a steward's 1024-px JPEG
303     is too large for a browser tab, so the small PNG beside it stands in when it exists (vendor/brand/<stem>.png - a
304     bright tile with the steward's initial, legible at 16 px); an SVG or a small image is linked as it is."""
305     stem = anchor_tab_stem() if anchor is None or anchor else None
306     if anchor is None:
307         anchor = bool(stem)
308     if anchor:
309         v, stem = esc(build), stem or "anchor-icon"
310         touch = ('<link rel="apple-touch-icon" sizes="180x180" href="/vendor/brand/anchor-icon-180.png?v=%s">' % v)
311         return ('<link rel="icon" href="/vendor/brand/%s.ico?v=%s" sizes="%s">'
312                 '<link rel="icon" type="image/png" sizes="32x32" href="/vendor/brand/%s-32.png?v=%s">'
313                 '<link rel="icon" type="image/png" sizes="16x16" href="/vendor/brand/%s-16.png?v=%s">'
314                 % (stem, v, ANCHOR_TAB_SIZES if stem == "anchor-tab" else ANCHOR_ICON_SIZES, stem, v, stem, v)) + touch
315     base = str(name or "gwl-m-icon.svg")
316     stem, _, ext = base.rpartition(".")
317     if ext.lower() in ("jpg", "jpeg") and (BRAND_DIR / (stem + ".png")).is_file():
318         return '<link rel="icon" href="/vendor/brand/%s.png?v=%s" type="image/png" sizes="64x64">' % (esc(stem), esc(build))
319     ctype = "image/svg+xml" if ext.lower() == "svg" else ("image/png" if ext.lower() == "png" else "image/jpeg")
320     return '<link rel="icon" href="/vendor/brand/%s?v=%s" type="%s">' % (esc(base), esc(build), ctype)

323 _ANY_ICON_LINK = re.compile(r'<link\b[^>]*\brel=["\'](?:shortcut icon|icon)["\'][^>]*>', re.I)
324 _OLD_ANCHOR_LINK = re.compile(r'<link\b[^>]*\brel=["\'](?:shortcut icon|icon|apple-touch-icon)["\'][^>]*\bhref=["\'](?:/anchor(?:-touch)?\.(?:ico|png)|/vendor/brand/anchor-icon[-.])[^"\']*["\'][^>]*>\s*', re.I)
325 _HEAD_OPEN = re.compile(r"<head\b[^>]*>", re.I)
326 _HEAD_CLOSE = re.compile(r"</head\s*>", re.I)
327 _SCRIPT_OR_BODY = re.compile(r"<(?:script|body)\b", re.I)
328

330 def with_tab_icon(html_text, build):
331     """Every page the server sends wears his anchor in its tab (2026-10-01, his fourth ask: "where are my icons in
332     Chrome tabs?"). What his tab strip showed: the Desk still linked the lamp painting, the cockpit linked the old
333     /anchor.ico with no version (Chrome keeps a tab icon it has seen for a week, whatever the cache header says), and a
334     page with no link at all waited on /favicon.ico. One rule at the one door (``_send_html``), and only once the tab
335     drawing is on disk (his dark export is never written onto a tab that has something else - Grok W3d): a page that
336     already links the drawing is left; the old anchor links (/anchor.ico, /anchor.png, his export's set) become the
337     drawing's set, with the build in the address so a new icon is a new address; a page with no icon gets the set; a
338     page with a mark of its own (a tool's) keeps it. Only a real head is touched: the one that opens before any script
339     or body and closes with </head>."""
340     if anchor_tab_stem() != "anchor-tab":
341         return html_text
342     window = html_text[:4096]
343     m = _HEAD_OPEN.search(window)
344     first = _SCRIPT_OR_BODY.search(window)
345     close = _HEAD_CLOSE.search(html_text, m.end()) if m else None
346     if not m or not close or (first and first.start() < m.start()):
347         return html_text
348     head = html_text[m.end():close.start()]
349     if "/vendor/brand/anchor-tab.ico" in head:
350         return html_text
351     bare = _OLD_ANCHOR_LINK.sub("", head)
352     if _ANY_ICON_LINK.search(bare):
353         return html_text                                       # a mark of its own
354     return html_text[:m.end()] + tab_icon_link(None, build) + bare + html_text[close.start():]

478 KIND_WORDS = {"project": "cockpit", "effort": "cockpit within", "task": "desk item", "step": "a step of a project", "deliverable": "deliverable", "calendar": "date"}
479 SEAT_WORDS = {"active": "active", "deck": "on deck"}

483 def _goal_rows(ctx, live, camp_pid):
484     """The goals expanded (W2c, 2026-09-30, his three levels): each goal a row that opens to its components. An
485     initiative in its goal (a cockpit, a cockpit within a project, a desk item) drags out to a shelf or takes a button;
486     a seated one is marked and comes back; an element (a step, a deliverable, a date) rides inside its goal."""
487     working = ctx.get("working") or set()
488     rows = []
489     for i in goals_only(live):
490         comps = [p for p in i["parts"] if not p.get("closed")]
491         out = [p for p in comps if p.get("seat")]
492         home = [p for p in comps if not p.get("seat")]      # what is still inside the goal: every open component with no seat (Grok's read of W2c)
493         light = initiative_light(i, working)
494         glyph, word = LIGHTS[light]
495 
496         def irow(p):
497             kind = KIND_WORDS.get(p["kind"], p["kind"])
498             name = esc(part_name(p))
499             if p.get("broken"):
500                 return '<div class="irow broken"><span class="kind">%s</span><span class="nm">%s</span><span class="el">broken reference: %s</span></div>' % (kind, esc(p.get("text") or name), esc(p.get("gap") or ""))
501             if not is_initiative(p):      # an element is named for what it is, its project as the suffix
502                 where = (' <span class="dim">&middot; %s</span>' % esc(p["target"])) if p.get("target") else ""
503                 return '<div class="irow el"><span class="kind">%s</span><span class="nm">%s%s</span><span class="el">rides inside &mdash; not pulled out on its own</span></div>' % (kind, esc(p.get("text") or name), where)
504             if p.get("seat"):
505                 return ('<div class="irow seated" data-step="%s"><span class="kind">%s</span><span class="nm">%s</span><span class="seat %s">%s</span>'
506                         '<button class="mini" data-home="%s" title="back into this goal">back</button></div>') % (
507                     esc(p["id"]), kind, name, p["seat"], SEAT_WORDS[p["seat"]], esc(p["id"]))
508             need = ' <span class="need">&#9873; needs you</span>' if p.get("needs_you") else ""
509             return ('<div class="irow" draggable="true" data-step="%s" data-name="%s"><span class="kind">%s</span><span class="nm">%s%s</span>'
510                     '<span class="acts"><button class="mini" data-seat="deck" data-step="%s">&rarr; on deck</button><button class="mini" data-seat="active" data-step="%s">&rarr; active</button></span></div>') % (
511                 esc(p["id"]), name, kind, name, need, esc(p["id"]), esc(p["id"]))
512         tier_word = ("tier %d" % i["tier"]) if i["tier"] in (1, 2) else "seed goal"
513         n_act, n_deck = sum(1 for p in out if p["seat"] == "active"), sum(1 for p in out if p["seat"] == "deck")
514         summary = "%d in the goal" % len(home) + ((" &middot; out: %s" % ", ".join(x for x in (("%d active" % n_act) if n_act else "", ("%d on deck" % n_deck) if n_deck else "") if x)) if out else "")
515         rows.append(
516             '<div class="grow%s" data-g="%s"><div class="gh"><b class="gn">%s</b><span class="t">%s</span><span class="ilight %s">%s %s</span><span class="c">%s</span>'
517             '<a class="gopen" href="/project/%s?open=%s" target="_blank" rel="noopener" title="its place on the %s">its place &#8599;</a></div>'
518             '<div class="inits">%s</div></div>' % (
519                 " needs" if i["needs"] else "", esc(i["id"]), esc(i["name"]), tier_word, light, glyph, word, summary,
520                 esc(camp_pid), esc(i["id"]), esc(mode_name(ctx.get("steward"))),
521                 "".join(irow(p) for p in comps) or '<div class="irow el"><span class="el">no component yet &mdash; add one in its place on the %s</span></div>' % esc(mode_name(ctx.get("steward")))))
522     return "".join(rows)
523

525 def _campaign_tile(ctx):
526     """The goals on the home (W2c, 2026-09-30, his lock of the three levels): ONE thin line — Tier 1 named, Tier 2 and
527     the seed goals counted, how many initiatives are out — that expands to the goals and their components (each goal a
528     row that opens). The tile is where a seated initiative is dropped to go home, and a goal's row is where a registry
529     project is dropped to become its component. Closed by default; the head toggles it."""
530     camp = ctx.get("campaign")
531     inits = ctx.get("initiatives") or []
532     if not camp:
533         return ('<section class="camp" id="camp"><div class="camp-h" id="campHead"><span class="k">Goals</span>'
534                 '<span class="d">&middot; not stood up yet &mdash; the record arrives with the import, after your seed check</span>'
535                 '<span class="sp"></span></div></section>')
536     live = [i for i in inits if i["status"] not in ("done", "parked")]
537     t1 = [i for i in goals_only(live) if i["tier"] == 1]
538     t2 = [i for i in live if i["tier"] == 2]
539     seedy = [i for i in goals_only(live) if i["tier"] not in (1, 2)]
540     act = seated(live, "active")
541     deck = seated(live, "deck")
542     line = ('&middot; <b>Tier 1:</b> %s &middot; <b>Tier 2:</b> %d &middot; <b>seed goals:</b> %d &middot; <b>out:</b> %d active, %d on deck' % (
543         esc(" · ".join(i["name"] for i in t1)) if t1 else "none yet", len(t2), len(seedy) + int(ctx.get("seeds") or 0), len(act), len(deck)))      # one seed-goal count (Grok W2c): the goals not in tier 1 or 2, and the seeds
544     body = '<div class="grows">%s</div>' % (_goal_rows(ctx, live, camp["pid"]) or '<div class="camp-note">No goal yet &mdash; the %s makes one.</div>' % esc(mode_name(ctx.get("steward"))))
545     return (
546         '<section class="camp" id="camp" data-drop="home"><div class="camp-h" id="campHead"><span class="k">Goals</span>'
547         '<span class="d" id="campLine">%s</span><span class="sp"></span><span class="tog" id="campTog">Expand</span>'
548         '<a class="camp-open" href="/project/%s" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open the %s</a></div>'
549         '<div class="camp-body" id="campBody">%s</div></section>'
550     ) % (line, esc(camp["pid"]), esc(mode_name(ctx.get("steward"))), body)
551

553 def _desk_card(ctx, g, p):

560     date = (' &middot; %s' % esc(_hr.due_label(p["date"], ctx["today"]))) if p.get("date") else ""
561     dot = '<span class="tlight %s" title="%s"></span>' % (("orange", "needs you") if p.get("needs_you") else ("gray", "idle"))      # a desk card has a light too (Grok's read of W2e)
562     return (
563         '<article class="tile desk%s" id="card-%s" data-step="%s" data-name="%s" draggable="true"><div class="t-top">' + dot + '<h3 class="t-name"><span class="t-nm">%s</span><span class="t-eff">at the desk%s</span></h3>'
564         '<button class="t-x" data-home="%s" title="back to its goal">&times;</button></div><div class="t-goal">in <b>%s</b></div>%s'
565         '<div class="t-acts"><a class="t-talk" href="/project/%s?view=desk" target="_blank" rel="noopener">talk to the desk &#8599;</a></div></article>'
566     ) % (" need" if p.get("needs_you") else "", esc(p["id"]), esc(p["id"]), esc(part_name(p)), esc(part_name(p)), date, esc(p["id"]), esc(g["name"]), line,
567          esc((ctx.get("campaign") or {}).get("pid") or ""))

570 def _zone(sid, seat, title, n, note, cards, empty):
571     return (
572         '<section class="shelf zone" id="%s" data-seat="%s"><div class="shelf-h"><h3>%s</h3><span class="c">%d</span><span class="rule"></span><span class="note">%s</span></div>'

576 def _seat_shelves(ctx):
577     """ACTIVE and ON DECK (W2c): two shelves of initiative cards in his order — the project card as today (the light,
578     what needs him, Status · Next steps · Deliverables · Plan · Resume · the cockpit), a cockpit within a project on
579     its own effort, a desk item's card that talks to the desk — each naming its goal, each with a × that sends it home.
580     No cap: a wide Active is named, never refused."""
581     inits = [i for i in ctx.get("initiatives") or [] if i["status"] not in ("done", "parked")]
582     entries = {e.get("id"): e for e in ctx.get("entries") or []}
583     facts = ctx["facts"]
584 
585     def cards(seat):
586         out = []
587         for g, p in seated(inits, seat):
588             if p["kind"] in ("project", "effort") and entries.get(p["pid"]):
589                 e = entries[p["pid"]]
590                 f = facts.get(p["pid"]) or {}
591                 if p["kind"] == "effort":      # the card reads THAT effort: its directory, its own wait and next (Grok's read of W2c)
592                     st_ = str(p.get("state") or "")
593                     wait = re.sub(r"^waiting on you[:\s]*", "", st_, flags=re.I).strip(" .") if st_.lower().startswith("waiting on you") else ""
594                     f = dict(f, effort=p.get("dir") or f.get("effort") or "", needs_you=wait or ("" if st_ else f.get("needs_you") or ""), needs_you_effort="", other_waits=[],
595                              wait_age_days=None, next=p.get("lead") or p.get("text") or f.get("next") or "", repair_proposals=[], efforts_gap="")
596                 lights = ctx.get("lights") or {}
597                 lt = lights.get(p["pid"] + "|" + str(p.get("dir") or "")) if p["kind"] == "effort" else lights.get(p["pid"])      # W2e-7: the card's OWN cockpit's light, an effort's keyed by its directory
598                 out.append(_card(e, f, "", goal=g, step=p, light=lt))
599             else:
600                 out.append(_desk_card(ctx, g, p))
601         return "".join(out)
602     a, d = cards("active"), cards("deck")
603     n_a, n_d = len(seated(inits, "active")), len(seated(inits, "deck"))
604     return (
605         _zone("shActive", "active", "Active", n_a, "what you are working on now, in your order &mdash; drag an initiative here from a goal above or from On deck", a,
606               "nothing active &mdash; pull an initiative out of a goal above, or drag one up from On deck")
607         + _zone("shDeck", "deck", "On deck", n_d, "out of its goal, not active &mdash; needs attention; the pick-up reads from here", d, "nothing on deck"))
608

653 def _resume_act(pid, rel, r):
654     """W5 (2026-09-28): Resume — where he left this record (W0's leave receipt), opened in the cockpit AT that step
655     (`?step=` opens the plan's fold that holds it, scrolls to it and marks it once); the act's title says the step
656     and when, and "nothing moved since" when the roadmap has not moved (the count itself stays on the fact — a
657     number with no decision behind it is not for the card, Grok W5). No receipt, no act."""
658     if not isinstance(r, dict) or not r.get("at"):
659         return ""
660     since = r.get("events_since")
661     moved = " &middot; nothing moved since" if since == 0 else ""     # the count stays on the fact; the title says only the zero (Grok W5)
662     href = "/project/%s?dir=%s%s" % (pid, esc(rel), ("&amp;step=%s" % esc(r.get("step_id"))) if r.get("step_id") else "")
663     return ('<a class="t-resume" href="%s" target="_blank" rel="noopener" title="you left at %s (%s)%s">&#8617; Resume <span class="t-age">%s</span></a>'
664             % (href, esc(r.get("step") or "where you were"), esc(r.get("ago") or r.get("at")), moved, esc(r.get("ago") or "")))
665

667 def _card(e, f, cls, goal=None, step=None, light=None):
668     """A project's one card, compact (John, 2026-09-27: "the tiles still seem larger than needed"): the name with the
669     effort it reads as a small suffix, ONE line — the Needs-you sentence when there is one, else the next step —
670     clamped to two lines, and the acts on one line, Status first (his word: "there should also be a status option");
671     the cockpit link sits by the name. The description and the next step behind a wait show only once the card
672     opens (the effort is named by the suffix and again by the Status part — no third line, Grok R7). The name
673     ellipsizes; the suffix stays whole (Grok R7: the effort is the datum the suffix exists for). The parts are read
674     from the cockpit's own readers on the effort the card names (home_rows.current_effort → ``data-dir``). A project
675     with no record is a quiet card: the name, its blurb, the cockpit."""
676     pid = esc(e.get("id"))
677     rel = esc(f.get("effort") or "")
678     # A seated component has its own Campaign name; the project is context, not its title.
679     name = esc((step or {}).get("name") or e.get("name"))
680     # W2c (2026-09-30): on a shelf the card is a seated initiative — it carries its step, drags, has its × and names
681     # its goal; a cockpit within a project is its own card on its own effort
682     cid = pid if not (step and step.get("kind") == "effort") else "%s-%s" % (pid, esc(step["id"]))
683     attr = (' data-step="%s" data-name="%s" draggable="true"' % (esc(step["id"]), name)) if step else ""
684     # W4 of the two-lane plan (2026-10-05, his rule): the light is orange exactly when something waits on him (the
685     # engine's one rule), and the edge pulses exactly when the light is orange. Looking does not resolve the request.
686     lt = light if isinstance(light, dict) else {}
687     lclass = lt.get("light") if lt.get("light") in LIGHT_WORDS else "gray"
688     dot = '<span class="tlight %s" title="%s"></span>' % (lclass, esc((LIGHT_WORDS[lclass] + ((": " + lt["why"]) if lt.get("why") else ""))[:200]))
689     if lclass == "orange":   # W4 (2026-10-05, his rule): the edge pulses exactly when the light is orange
690         import hashlib as _hl
691         attr += ' data-ready="%s"' % _hl.sha1((str(lt.get("why") or "") + "|" + str(f.get("needs_you") or "")).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:10]
692     xbtn = ('<button class="t-x" data-home="%s" title="back to its goal">&times;</button>' % esc(step["id"])) if step else ""
693     goal_line = ('<div class="t-goal">in <b>%s</b> &middot; %s</div>' % (esc(goal["name"]), "a cockpit within the project" if step.get("kind") == "effort" else "the project&rsquo;s cockpit")) if (goal and step) else ""
694     if not f.get("has_record"):
695         return (
696             '<article class="tile quiet%s" id="card-%s" data-tile="%s"%s><div class="t-top">%s<h3 class="t-name">%s</h3>%s</div>%s'
697             '<div class="t-desc">%s</div><div class="t-quiet">no steward record yet &middot; <a class="t-open" href="/project/%s" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open cockpit</a></div></article>'
698         ) % (cls, cid, pid, attr, dot, name, xbtn, goal_line, esc((e.get("blurb") or "").strip()[:160]) or "&mdash;", pid)
699     wait = " ".join(str(f.get("needs_you") or "").split())[:160]
700     nxt = esc((f.get("next") or "")[:160]) or "not stated"
701     # W1 (2026-09-28): EVERY effort's wait, each opening its own record (the Status part on that effort) — a
702     # project's second effort no longer disappears behind the one touched last. A wait promoted from another
703     # effort (the shown one has none) is that effort's line, with its open; the rest follow it.
704     promoted = str(f.get("needs_you_effort") or "")
705     other_waits = [x for x in (f.get("other_waits") or []) if isinstance(x, dict)]
706 
707     def _eff_line(x):
708         a = x.get("age_days")
709         a_s = (' <span class="t-age">&middot; %d day%s</span>' % (int(a), "" if int(a) == 1 else "s")) if isinstance(a, (int, float)) and a >= 1 else ""
710         return ('<div class="t-line wait"><span class="mk">&#9873; %s:</span>%s%s '
711                 '<button class="t-eff-open" data-part="status" data-pid="%s" data-dir="%s">open</button></div>') % (
712             esc(x.get("name")), esc(" ".join(str(x.get("needs_you") or "").split())[:160]), a_s, pid, esc(x.get("rel")))
713     lead_x = next((x for x in other_waits if str(x.get("rel") or "") == promoted), None) if (wait and promoted) else None
714     if lead_x is not None:
715         line = _eff_line(lead_x)
716         # the Next line is the SHOWN effort's, named, so a promoted wait never reads as that effort's next (Grok W1)
717         more_next = '<div class="t-next"><span class="k">Next &middot; %s</span>%s</div>' % (rel or "root", nxt)
718     elif wait:
719         # W2 (2026-09-28): the age of the wait, from the record (home_rows._wait_age_days) — nothing when unknown
720         age = f.get("wait_age_days")
721         age_s = (' <span class="t-age">&middot; %d day%s</span>' % (int(age), "" if int(age) == 1 else "s")) if isinstance(age, (int, float)) and age >= 1 else ""
722         line = '<div class="t-line wait"><span class="mk">&#9873; Needs you:</span>%s%s</div>' % (esc(wait), age_s)
723         more_next = '<div class="t-next"><span class="k">Next</span>%s</div>' % nxt
724     else:
725         line = '<div class="t-line"><span class="k">Next</span>%s</div>' % nxt
726         more_next = ""
727     for x in other_waits:
728         if x is lead_x:
729             continue
730         line += _eff_line(x).replace('class="t-line wait"', 'class="t-line wait other"', 1)
731     if f.get("efforts_gap"):
732         line += '<div class="t-line dim">&#9888; %s</div>' % esc(f["efforts_gap"])   # never a silent empty list (Grok W1)
733     # W4 (2026-09-28): a repair PROPOSED after an acceptance waits on his word — "proposed: N corrections"; the Status
734     # part shows the set with accept and dismiss; nothing inside approved work changes before (his Q2)
735     props = [p for p in (f.get("repair_proposals") or []) if isinstance(p, dict)]
736     if props:
737         n = sum(int(p.get("count") or 0) for p in props)
738         line += ('<div class="t-line prop"><span class="mk">&#9881; proposed:</span>%d correction%s '
739                  '<button class="t-eff-open" data-part="status" data-pid="%s" data-dir="%s">see</button></div>') % (n, "" if n == 1 else "s", pid, rel)
740     acts = "".join('<button data-part="%s" data-pid="%s" data-dir="%s">%s</button>' % (part, pid, rel, label) for part, label in _ACTS)
741     acts += _resume_act(pid, rel, f.get("resume"))
742     cockpit_href = "/steward/v1?pid=%s&amp;dir=%s" % (pid, esc(_quote(str(f.get("effort") or ""))))
743     return (
744         '<article class="tile%s" id="card-%s" data-tile="%s" data-dir="%s"%s><div class="t-top">%s<h3 class="t-name"><span class="t-nm">%s</span>%s</h3>'
745         '<a class="t-go" href="%s" target="_blank" rel="noopener" title="Open the cockpit">cockpit &#8599;</a>%s</div><div class="t-face">%s'
746         '%s<div class="t-more"><div class="t-desc">%s</div>%s</div></div>'
747         '<div class="t-acts">%s</div>'
748         '<div class="t-body" hidden></div></article>'
749     ) % (cls, cid, pid, rel, attr, dot, name, ('<span class="t-eff">&middot; %s</span>' % esc(e.get("name"))) if step else (('<span class="t-eff">&middot; %s</span>' % rel) if rel else ""), cockpit_href, xbtn, goal_line,
750          line, esc((e.get("blurb") or "").strip()[:220]) or "&mdash;", more_next, acts)

767 def _ruler(ctx):
768     weeks, buckets, beyond, overdue = ruler_markers(list(ctx["facts"].values()), ctx["today"])
769     head = "".join('<div%s><b>%s</b><span class="sm">%s</span></div>' % (' class="now"' if k == 0 else "", esc(w["label"]), esc(w["name"])) for k, w in enumerate(weeks))
770     head += '<div class="beyond"><b>%s&ndash;</b><span class="sm">beyond the ruler</span></div>' % esc(_hr.short_date((weeks[-1]["end"] + timedelta(days=1)).isoformat()))
771     on_board = ctx.get("on_board") or set()
772 
773     def marker(m):
774         where = ("&#9873; " if m["needs"] else "") + (("seated on %s" % on_board[m["project_id"]]) if m["project_id"] in on_board else "in the Projects tile")      # W2c: the shelves are the seats
775         return ('<a class="mkcard%s" href="/project/%s" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><span class="mk-date">%s</span><span class="mk-what">%s%s</span>'
776                 '<span class="mk-proj">%s</span><span class="mk-where">%s</span></a>' % (
777                     " late" if m["overdue"] else "", esc(m["project_id"]), esc(_short(m["date"])), esc(m["name"]),
778                     " &middot; overdue" if m["overdue"] else (" &middot; &#9873; needs you" if m["needs"] else ""), esc(m["project_name"]), where))
779     cols = []
780     for k in range(5):
781         inner = "".join(marker(m) for m in buckets[k])
782         if k == 0 and not inner:
783             nearest = next((m for kk in range(1, 5) for m in buckets[kk]), None) or (beyond[0] if beyond else None)
784             inner = '<p class="empty-week"><b>This week, %s</b>No registered delivery this week. %s</p>' % (
785                 esc(weeks[0]["label"]), ("Nearest: %s, %s." % (esc(nearest["name"]), esc(_short(nearest["date"])))) if nearest else "Nothing carries a date yet.")
786         cols.append('<div%s id="week%d">%s</div>' % (' class="now"' if k == 0 else "", k + 1, inner))
787     cols.append('<div class="beyond" id="weekBeyond">%s</div>' % "".join(marker(m) for m in beyond[:8]))
788     total = sum(len(v) for v in buckets.values()) + len(beyond) + len(overdue)
789     late = ('<div class="shelf-foot late">Overdue, before this week: %s.</div>' % "; ".join(
790         '<a href="/project/%s" target="_blank" rel="noopener">%s</a> (%s, %s)' % (esc(m["project_id"]), esc(m["name"]), esc(_short(m["date"])), esc(m["project_name"]))
791         for m in overdue[:6])) if overdue else ""
792     return (
793         '<section class="shelf" id="shDated"><div class="shelf-h"><h3>Dated deliveries</h3><span class="c">%d dated step%s</span><span class="rule"></span>'
794         '<span class="note">Each marker is a dated open step in a project&rsquo;s record. Click one to balloon it open.</span></div>'
795         '<div class="ruler" id="ruler"><div class="rl-head">%s</div><div class="rl-marks" id="rlMarks">%s</div></div>'
796         '%s<div class="shelf-foot">Each marker points at the one card that owns it &mdash; no project has a second card.</div>'
797         '<section class="cal" id="cal"><button class="cal-h" id="calHead"><span class="k">Calendar</span><span class="state">&middot; not connected</span>'
798         '<span class="cal-tab" id="tabCal">Calendar</span><span class="cal-tab" id="tabMail">Email</span><span class="sp"></span><span class="tog" id="calTog">Open</span></button>'
799         '<div class="cal-body" id="calBody"><p class="conn-zero">No account is connected, so there is nothing to show &mdash; nothing here is sample data. '
800         'Connecting means two app registrations (Google, Microsoft) and a sign-in per account; Anchor would read before it ever writes, and every send or calendar change would ask you first.</p></div></section>'
801         '</section>'
802     ) % (total, "" if total == 1 else "s", head, "".join(cols), late)

830 KIND_LABEL = {"project": "cockpit", "effort": "cockpit within a project", "task": "desk item"}
831 _RECORD_FILES = ("ECGBERHT.md", "roadmap.json", "strip.json", ".ecgberht/conversation-log.json", ".ecgberht/status-summary.json")

834 _DATES_CACHE = {}
835 
836 
837 def cockpit_dates(folder):
838     """Cached a minute (the SLOW samples, 2026-10-02: every candidate's record files stat'ed on every load)."""
839     import time as _time
840     hit = _DATES_CACHE.get(folder)
841     if hit and _time.time() - hit[0] < 60:
842         return hit[1]
843     out = _cockpit_dates(folder)
844     _DATES_CACHE[folder] = (_time.time(), out)
845     return out
846 
847 
848 def _cockpit_dates(folder):
849     """(created, last worked) of a cockpit's record, as dates: its Face's birth, and the newest of its record files.
850     Read-only stats; (None, None) when the folder holds no record."""
851     import os as _os
852     from datetime import datetime as _dt
853     born, last = None, None
854     for rel in _RECORD_FILES:
855         try:
856             st = _os.stat(_os.path.join(folder, rel))
857         except OSError:
858             continue
859         b = getattr(st, "st_birthtime", None) or st.st_ctime
860         if rel == "ECGBERHT.md":
861             born = b
862         last = max(last or 0, st.st_mtime)
863     d = lambda t: _dt.fromtimestamp(t).date().isoformat() if t else ""
864     return d(born), d(last)

867 def relevance(c, today, override=None):
868     """The steward's relevance score (0-100) for a candidate, with its reasons (his word, 2026-10-02: "how likely the
869     user is to want to/need to work on the project"). The steward's own score, when it has written one for this
870     candidate (Campaign/.ecgberht/relevance.json), stands; else the record's: what waits on him, how near its date,
871     its goal's tier, how recently it was worked, how long it has lain still."""
872     if isinstance(override, dict) and isinstance(override.get("score"), (int, float)):
873         return max(0, min(100, int(override["score"]))), str(override.get("why") or "the steward's own score")
874     from datetime import date as _date
875     score, why = 20, []
876     if c.get("needs"):
877         score += 35; why.append("waits on you")
878     due = str(c.get("due") or "")
879     if due:
880         try:
881             days = (_date.fromisoformat(due[:10]) - today).days
882             if days < 0:
883                 score += 30; why.append("overdue")
884             elif days <= 7:
885                 score += 22; why.append("due in %d day%s" % (days, "" if days == 1 else "s"))
886             elif days <= 21:
887                 score += 10; why.append("due %s" % due[:10])
888         except ValueError:
889             pass
890     tier = c.get("tier")
891     if tier == 1:
892         score += 15; why.append("a tier-1 goal")
893     elif tier == 2:
894         score += 7; why.append("a tier-2 goal")
895     worked = str(c.get("worked") or "")
896     if worked:
897         try:
898             ago = (today - _date.fromisoformat(worked[:10])).days
899             if ago <= 3:
900                 score += 12; why.append("worked %s" % ("today" if ago == 0 else "%d day%s ago" % (ago, "" if ago == 1 else "s")))
901             elif ago <= 14:
902                 score += 5; why.append("worked %d days ago" % ago)
903             elif ago > 45:
904                 score -= 10; why.append("still for %d days" % ago)
905         except ValueError:
906             pass
907     return max(0, min(100, score)), (", ".join(why) or "nothing presses")
908 
909 
910 def candidates(ctx):
911     """Everything he could put on deck or make active (his word, 2026-10-02: "a tile that can be expanded, right below
912     the on deck that shows all of the candidates -- those would be anything with an AI Cockpit as well as any open
913     tasks/efforts, e.g. of an admin nature in the desk"): (1) the open components inside a goal with no seat yet - a
914     cockpit, an effort, a desk item; (2) every AI cockpit (a project, or one of its efforts, with a steward record)
915     that is not on the Campaign at all. Read from the page's own context; nothing new is read from disk."""
916     inits = [i for i in ctx.get("initiatives") or () if i.get("status") not in ("done", "parked")]
917     in_goal = []
918     on_map = set()
919     for i in ctx.get("initiatives") or ():
920         for p in i.get("parts") or ():
921             if p.get("kind") in ("project", "effort") and p.get("pid"):
922                 on_map.add((p["pid"], p.get("dir") or ""))
923                 if p.get("kind") == "project":
924                     on_map.add((p["pid"], "*"))
925     facts = ctx.get("facts") or {}
926     today = ctx.get("today")
927     if today is None:
928         from datetime import date as _date
929         today = _date.today()
930     ev = ctx.get("campaign_step_dates") or {}
931     over = ctx.get("relevance_override") or {}
932     for i in goals_only(inits):
933         for p in i.get("parts") or ():
934             if p.get("kind") in KIND_LABEL and not p.get("seat") and not p.get("closed") and not p.get("broken"):
935                 made, touched = (ev.get(p.get("id")) or ("", ""))
936                 if p.get("pid") and facts.get(p["pid"], {}).get("folder"):
937                     import os as _os
938                     b, l = cockpit_dates(_os.path.join(facts[p["pid"]]["folder"], p.get("dir") or ""))
939                     touched = max(touched or "", l or "")
940                 p["c_created"], p["c_worked"] = made, touched
941                 p["c_score"], p["c_why"] = relevance({"needs": p.get("needs_you"), "due": p.get("date"), "tier": i.get("tier"), "worked": touched},
942                                                      today, over.get(p.get("id")))
943                 in_goal.append((i, p))
944     camp = (ctx.get("campaign") or {}).get("pid")
945     loose = []
946     for e in ctx.get("entries") or ():
947         pid = e.get("id")
948         f = facts.get(pid) or {}
949         if not pid or pid == camp or not f.get("has_record") or (pid, "*") in on_map:
950             continue
951         effs = [x for x in (f.get("efforts") or []) if isinstance(x, dict)]
952         if not effs:
953             if (pid, "") not in on_map:
954                 loose.append({"ref": "project:%s" % pid, "name": f.get("name") or e.get("name") or pid[:8], "where": "a project", "needs": bool(f.get("needs_you")), "folder": f.get("folder") or ""})
955             continue
956         for x in effs:
957             rel = str(x.get("rel") or "")
958             if (pid, rel) in on_map:
959                 continue
960             nm = f.get("name") or e.get("name") or pid[:8]
961             loose.append({"ref": ("effort:%s/%s" % (pid, _quote(rel))) if rel else ("project:%s" % pid),
962                           "name": ("%s · %s" % (nm, x.get("name") or rel)) if rel else nm,
963                           "where": ("an effort of %s" % nm) if rel else "a project", "needs": bool(x.get("needs_you")),
964                           "folder": (f.get("folder") or "") + (("/" + rel) if rel else "")})
965     for c in loose:
966         c["created"], c["worked"] = cockpit_dates(c["folder"]) if c.get("folder") else ("", "")
967         c["score"], c["why"] = relevance({"needs": c["needs"], "worked": c["worked"]}, today, over.get(c["ref"]))
968     return in_goal, loose
969

1062 def conversation_view(label, camp_pid, inst="main", dir_="", title="the conversation"):
1063     """A steward conversation as the AI Cockpit renders it - its blocks, its markdown, its live flow - and nothing else
1064     of the cockpit (his word, 2026-10-02: "I just want the steward dialogue from an AI Cockpit, maybe have the status
1065     bar available but thinner, and the plan is not something that we have to worry about in those pages"): the view
1066     /steward/v1?view=talk under a thin status line; the page's own box below carries the verbs, receipts and undo.
1067     ``dir_`` names the conversation: "" the Campaign's, CAVE_EFFORT the Cave of Wonders' own. The Deliverables bar
1068     lists what that conversation made."""
1069     src = "/steward/v1?embed=1&amp;view=talk&amp;inst=%s&amp;pid=%s&amp;dir=%s" % (esc(inst), esc(camp_pid), esc(_quote(dir_)))
1070     return (
1071         '<section class="exwrap cview" id="dialogue" data-dir="%s"><div class="exhead"><h3>%s &mdash; %s</h3><span class="exstate" id="exState" data-state="">&hellip;</span>'
1072         '<a class="note" href="/steward/v1?pid=%s&amp;dir=%s" target="_blank" rel="noopener" title="this conversation in its cockpit, full size">open in the cockpit &#8599;</a></div>'
1073         '<iframe class="cview-frame" src="%s" title="%s &mdash; %s"></iframe>'
1074         '<ul class="ex" id="exList" hidden></ul></section>'
1075         '<section class="delivbar" id="delivBar" data-pid="%s" data-dir="%s"><button class="db-h" id="delivToggle" type="button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="delivList">'
1076         '<span class="db-t">Deliverables</span><span class="db-c" id="delivCount">&hellip;</span><span class="db-caret">&#9662;</span></button>'
1077         '<ul class="db-list" id="delivList" hidden></ul></section>'
1078     ) % (esc(dir_), esc(label), esc(title), esc(camp_pid), esc(_quote(dir_)),
1079          src, esc(label), esc(title), esc(camp_pid), esc(dir_))

1165 def render_locked_html(ctx) -> str:
1166     """The Cave with no login (his word, 2026-10-03: "lock the Cave too"): over Tailscale the page showed the whole
1167     portfolio before any token, only the steward's words were refused. Now a request with neither the login cookie nor
1168     a valid token sees the anchor and a token box, nothing of the record. A token this device already saved logs in by
1169     itself; a pasted one is checked by POST /api/auth/login (which mints the 30-day cookie) and the page reloads into
1170     the Cave. PUTER's own browser and program are logged in by the server (the loopback cookie), so they never see it."""
1171     b = ctx.get("build") or ""
1172     return (
1173         '<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">'
1174         '<title>Anchor - locked</title>%s'
1175         '<style>:root{color-scheme:dark}body{margin:0;min-height:100vh;display:grid;place-items:center;background:#0f141c;color:#e6ebf2;'
1176         'font:15px/1.5 "Segoe UI Variable Text","Segoe UI",system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif;padding:16px;box-sizing:border-box}'
1177         '.card{width:min(440px,100%%);background:#161d29;border:1px solid #2b3546;border-radius:12px;padding:26px 28px;text-align:center}'
1178         '.card img{width:56px;height:56px;border-radius:12px}h1{font-size:19px;margin:12px 0 4px}p{color:#98a4b8;margin:0 0 16px}'
1179         'input{width:100%%;box-sizing:border-box;font:15px system-ui;padding:9px 11px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #3a4658;background:#0f141c;color:#e6ebf2}'
1180         'input:focus{outline:2px solid #e0a836;outline-offset:1px}button{margin-top:12px;font:600 14px system-ui;padding:8px 18px;border-radius:8px;'
1181         'border:1px solid #e0a836;background:#e0a836;color:#1a1a1a;cursor:pointer}#msg{min-height:22px;margin-top:10px;color:#e0a836;font-size:14px}</style>'
1182         '</head><body><div class="card"><img src="/vendor/brand/anchor-icon-180.png?v=%s" alt="">'
1183         '<h1>Anchor is locked</h1><p>Paste your Anchor token to open the Cave of Wonders on this device. You only do this once.</p>'
1184         '<input id="tok" type="password" autocomplete="off" placeholder="paste the token here" aria-label="Anchor token">'
1185         '<button id="go" type="button">Open the Cave</button><div id="msg" role="status"></div></div>'
1186         '<script>(function(){var tok=document.getElementById("tok"),go=document.getElementById("go"),msg=document.getElementById("msg");'
1187         'function login(t,quiet){go.disabled=true;if(!quiet)msg.textContent="Checking…";'
1188         'return fetch("/api/auth/login",{method:"POST",headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json","X-Anchor-Token":t},body:JSON.stringify({token:t})})'
1189         '.then(function(r){go.disabled=false;if(r.ok){try{localStorage.setItem("anchor_token",t)}catch(e){}location.reload();return}'
1190         'try{localStorage.removeItem("anchor_token")}catch(e){}msg.textContent=r.status===401?(quiet?"The token saved here is out of date - paste the current one.":"That token was refused - it is not the current one."):"That did not go through; try again."})'
1191         '.catch(function(){go.disabled=false;msg.textContent="Anchor did not answer; try again."})}'
1192         'go.addEventListener("click",function(){var t=tok.value.trim();if(!t){msg.textContent="Paste the token first.";return}login(t)});'
1193         'tok.addEventListener("keydown",function(e){if(e.key==="Enter"){e.preventDefault();go.click()}});'
1194         'var saved="";try{saved=localStorage.getItem("anchor_token")||""}catch(e){}if(saved)login(saved,true);else tok.focus();})();</script>'
1195         '</body></html>'
1196     ) % (tab_icon_link(None, b), esc(b))

1211 def render_high_seat_html(ctx) -> str:
1212     """The whole page from the context dict (see the module docstring)."""
1213     if ctx.get("auth_required") and not ctx.get("logged_in"):
1214         return render_locked_html(ctx)                  # no login, no record (2026-10-03)
1215     facts = ctx["facts"]
1216     entries = ctx.get("entries") or []
1217     by_id = {e.get("id"): e for e in entries}
1218     parked = ctx.get("parked") or []
1219     parked_ids = {e.get("id") for e in parked}
1220     inits = ctx.get("initiatives") or []
1221     live_inits = [i for i in inits if i.get("status") not in ("done", "parked")]
1222     # W2c (2026-09-30, his three levels): the goals as a thin tile, then ACTIVE and ON DECK as shelves of initiative
1223     # cards; the Projects tile (the registry) with its projects in no goal; the Desk, the ruler and the Workbench as
1224     # before. The old shelves (Needs you · Continuing · Parked) are gone: a project is on a shelf because he seated
1225     # it, and every project is in the Projects tile.
1226     in_goal = {p["pid"] for i in inits for p in i.get("parts") or () if p.get("kind") in ("project", "effort") and p.get("pid")}
1227     camp_pid = (ctx.get("campaign") or {}).get("pid")
1228     ctx["orphans"] = [e for e in entries if e.get("id") and e["id"] not in in_goal and e["id"] != camp_pid and e["id"] not in parked_ids]
1229     ctx["quiet_n"] = sum(1 for e in entries if not (facts.get(e.get("id")) or {}).get("has_record") and e.get("id") not in parked_ids)
1230     ctx["on_board"] = {p["pid"]: SEAT_NAMES[seat] for seat in ("deck", "active") for g, p in seated(live_inits, seat) if p.get("pid")}      # Active wins when a project has cards on both (Grok's read of W2c)
1231     board = ('<div class="board">' + lane_html(ctx.get("lane"), ctx.get("resume_from") or "") + _campaign_tile(ctx) + _seat_shelves(ctx) + _candidates_tile(ctx) + _projects_tile(ctx)
1232              + _desk_line(ctx) + _ruler(ctx) + _terminal(ctx) + '</div>')
1233     page = (
1234         '<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">'
1235         '<title>%s</title>%s'
1236         '<link rel="stylesheet" href="/static/steward-dialogue.css?v=%s"><link rel="stylesheet" href="/static/high-seat-page.css?v=%s">'
1237         '<script>window.ANCHOR_BOOT = {build_id: "%s", campaign_pid: "%s", auth_required: %s, logged_in: %s, steward: "%s", stamp: "%s", you: "%s"};window.ANCHOR_TILES = {%s};</script></head>'
